reviews.author: Darrick J. Wong
reviews.summary: Identified the patch as a good improvement to the iomap iteration mechanism and provided a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new callback, ->iomap_next(), which replaces the existing ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() callbacks in the iomap iteration mechanism. The goal is to improve performance by allowing callers to inline their iteration loop and pass the ->iomap_next() function as a compile-time constant.
